subject: Request: Geo Hosting Operations Playbook & VPC Runbook for EU and APAC
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@medicorp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Geo hosting request - playbook & runbook for EU/APAC

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our procurement security review we need a concise operations pack that confirms how Redwood hosts customer workloads in EU and APAC regions when customers opt for a private deployment (VPC/private link). Specifically we need:

- An operations playbook overview describing: region selection, KMS partitioning (customer-specific keying), private peering options, and logging/retention for audit purposes.
- A step-by-step VPC runbook for provisioning and connecting the private endpoint (including CIDR guidance, endpoint types, and failover behavior).
- A simple network diagram showing where data egress occurs and where logs are collected.

We can accept a short PDF and a markdown runbook. Our SOC/Procurement team wants this by EOD Wednesday (2026-06-17) to keep the timeline on track. Can you confirm what you can provide and whether you can include a short note about KMS separation between regions?

Thanks,
Anita Rao
Senior Security Analyst
MediCorp
(Attachment: example-security-questionnaire.pdf - referenced)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@medicorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Geo hosting request - playbook & runbook for EU/APAC

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a compact playbook + runbook that addresses your three bullets. High level:

- Playbook: 2–3 page PDF covering region routing, KMS partitioning (per-account keys + region scoping), private peering options (PrivateLink, VPC peering, customer edge), and log retention defaults with configurable options.
- Runbook: step-by-step markdown for provisioning a private endpoint, recommended CIDR ranges, HA failover plan, and how to validate routing.
- Network diagram: simple PNG illustrating control plane vs data plane and where audit logs are stored (Cloud Logging instance per region with cross-region read-only replication for support).

We're marking Karthik to produce the runbook and diagram; Olga will include a short note about regional KMS scoping and zero-trust controls. Expect a draft by Monday EOD (2026-06-14) so you have time to review before Wednesday.

Quick Q: do you want the runbook to include Terraform snippets or keep it vendor-agnostic?

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Security & Compliance (Sales Engineering)
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: none)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@medicorp.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft: Geo hosting playbook + VPC runbook (EU/APAC)

Hi Anita / Hannah — attaching the initial drafts. Key implementation notes are inline. High level summary:

- KMS: we issue customer-specific keys scoped to account; for private deployments keys are created per-region to limit blast radius. Key policy samples are included in the appendix.
- Private connectivity: we support three connectivity models (PrivateLink with NAT egress, customer VPN to dedicated subnet, and direct peering). Recommendation for APAC is PrivateLink + regional egress for low-latency inference; fallback to cross-region peering for failover.
- Logs & retention: default 90 days for access/incidents, 365 days for audit trails (available as an add-on). Logs are written to a customer-owned logging bucket (or retained by Redwood per contract).

Attachments included (stubs):
- Redwood_Geo_Hosting_Playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)
- vpc-runbook-eu-apac.md (Markdown, runbook with commands and validation checks)
- network-diagram-eu-apac.png (PNG)

Notes for Anita: the runbook includes a short Terraform snippet but we can remove it if you prefer a cloud-neutral flow. Happy to redline based on your procurement team's preferences.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Redwood_Geo_Hosting_Playbook_v1.pdf, vpc-runbook-eu-apac.md, network-diagram-eu-apac.png)
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@medicorp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Geo hosting playbook + VPC runbook (EU/APAC)

Karthik / Hannah — thanks, this looks good at a glance and hits the items our SOC asked for. A couple quick asks before we mark as evidence for the procurement packet:

1) Can you add a one-paragraph confirmation that customer data for the EU tenant remains in EU region egress by default and describe the conditions for cross-region failover?
2) Please confirm whether Redwood will provide KMS key policy exports or a sample key policy (we need a record with algorithm and key identifiers).
3) For the network diagram, can you label the log collection endpoint and the retention SLA?

If you can upload the final PDF + runbook to a secure share (DocuSign/secure drive) and post the link here by EOD Wednesday we can attach to the SIG/CAIQ evidence bundle.

If helpful, our procurement lead (cc'd) can accept the DocuSign upload.

Thanks again — this keeps us on schedule.

—Anita
Senior Security Analyst, MediCorp
(Attachment: none)
